                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              What are the key features of the PS5 console?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The PlayStation 5 is jam-packed with innovative features that deliver an incredible gaming experience. From faster load times to breathtaking graphics, these are the cutting-edge features that set the PS5 apart from all the rest:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Crystal clear and silky smooth 4K/120fps gameplay with potential 8K support for mind-blowing clarity.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • An expertly engineered heat sink and fan system that provides cool and quiet operation, even during intense scenes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Lightning-quick storage that offers almost instantaneous load times, allowing you to jump right into the action.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Support for ray-traced graphics, which create lifelike lighting, shadows, and reflections in real-time.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Backward compatibility with PS4 games, providing long-time PlayStation fans with an extensive catalogue of games from day one.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • An SSD drive bay that lets you easily expand your storage, so all your favourite games are only ever one click away.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don’t forget to check out the rest of Sony’s catalogue of PlayStation consoles including the compact PS5 Slim or the PlayStation Edition Backbone One, a handheld game console designed to bring with you on the go.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              What is included in the PS5 game library?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Whether you’re a casual or hardcore gamer, the PS5 game library has a little something for everyone! You can choose from a wide range of PS5 games available as digital downloads or physical copies. The library is forever growing with regular updates, expansions, and the latest titles, so there’s always something new to play. Plus, you can still access most PS4 games, making it easy to continue playing your favourite titles from the previous generation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              What accessories do I need for the PS5?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The right PlayStation accessories can help you unleash your full potential. From wireless controllers to gaming audio, check out our must-have accessories for your PS5 console:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • PS5 Controllers – Take control with the DualSense controller, featuring haptic feedback technology and adaptive resistance triggers.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Gaming Headsets – Deliver crisp, distraction-free audio, allowing you to hear every detail no matter where you play.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • VR Headsets – Bring your games to life with next-generation virtual reality gaming.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Racing Simulators and Steering Wheels – Put yourself behind the wheel for a more realistic racing experience.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Internal SSDs and external hard drives – Add extra storage to make room for all the latest and greatest games, video clips, and more.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Gaming Chairs – Stay comfortable and focused during those long gaming sessions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Gaming Desks – Streamline your space, keeping your set-up organised and clutter-free.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Harvey Norman is your destination for all things gaming!
